rules.description: Q18 is required and must have a response.
Q18 must contain one of the seven listed response codes.
The required open-text response for Q19 must not be missing.
Q19 requires an open-text response containing the preferred vendor and reason.
Q19_New is required and must have at least one selected vendor.
Q19_New must use only the eleven listed vendor codes.
Q19_New is a multi-select question and responses must be represented as multiple-response data.
Q19b_vendor is required when the piped preferred-vendor question is displayed.
The required reason for the preferred vendor must not be missing.
Q19b_reason requires an open-text explanation.
The required percentage for piped vendor 1 must not be missing when applicable.
Q19c_1 is a percentage and must be between 0 and 100.
The vendor-share percentages across Q19c must total 100%.
The required percentage for piped vendor 2 must not be missing when applicable.
Q19c_2 is a percentage and must be between 0 and 100.
The required percentage for piped vendor 3 must not be missing when applicable.
Q19c_3 is a percentage and must be between 0 and 100.
The required percentage for piped vendor 4 must not be missing when applicable.
Q19c_4 is a percentage and must be between 0 and 100.
The required percentage for the other vendor row must not be missing when applicable.
Q19c_other is a percentage and must be between 0 and 100.
Q19A_1 is required and must have a response.
Q19A_1 must contain one of the five listed agreement-scale codes.
Check for identical responses across the six-item Q19A rating battery.

Q21 requires an open-text response describing the biggest barrier or unmet need.

warnings: Evidence-supported checks could not be emitted because every question in this batch has a null canonical variable. Emitting question IDs as response variables would invent identifiers and violate the supplied questionnaire metadata.

The canonical questionnaire does not provide SPSS variable names; canonical question IDs were used as validation targets. The exact piped-variable mapping for Q19b_vendor and Q19c rows is not supplied, so vendor-specific piping consistency checks were not added.
